description: This file defines the 'Content' entity class, which models content data in the application, including fields like id, code, descriptions, visibility, and relationships to other entities such as MerchantStore and ContentDescription. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Entity class representing content items, including metadata, descriptions, visibility, and associations with merchant stores and content descriptions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the content.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the content.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of descriptions associated with this content.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for this content.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Gets the code identifier of the content.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier of the content.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the content is visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility status of the content.

methods.name: getContentPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the position of the content.

methods.name: setContentPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the content.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns audit information for the entity.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets audit information for the entity.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this content.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the primary description of the content.
